<description>
Fix a pre-existing typo and https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36446#discussion_r4267602616
</description>

<commits>
fa13e8954d test: Fix block height typos in test logs

NODE_NETWORK_LIMITED_MIN_BLOCKS includes two blocks of buffer, so the
"tip-288" and "tip-289" comments were wrong. Also, the first mined block
is at height 1, not height 2.

fadcd0b64e test: Remove confusing ensure_for

There is no "trickle delay" for blocks, so a single ping should be
sufficient to drain any possible in-flight blocks.

Remvoe the ensure_for and directly assert the outcome.
</commits>

diff --git a/test/functional/p2p_node_network_limited.py b/test/functional/p2p_node_network_limited.py
index 225e19e01e..c3bfd384d0 100755

 from test_framework.util import (
     assert_equal,

-    ensure_for,

 )
 
@@ -127,11 +126,11 @@ class NodeNetworkLimitedTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         self.connect_nodes(0, 1)
         blocks = self.generate(self.nodes[1], 292, sync_fun=lambda: self.sync_blocks([self.nodes[0], self.nodes[1]]))
 
-        self.log.info("Make sure we can max retrieve block at tip-288.")

         node.wait_for_block(int(blocks[1], 16), timeout=3)
 
-        self.log.info("Requesting block at height 2 (tip-289) must fail (ignored).")
+        self.log.info("Requesting a block at height 1 (tip-291) must fail.")
         node.send_getdata_for_block(blocks[0])  # first block outside of the 288+2 limit
         node.wait_for_disconnect(timeout=5)
         self.nodes[0].disconnect_p2ps()
@@ -154,21 +153,12 @@ class NodeNetworkLimitedTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         full_node.ping()
         self.wait_until(lambda: full_node.getpeerinfo()[0]["bytesrecv_per_msg"].get("pong", 0) > received_pongs)
 
-        def no_block_request_from_limited_peer():
-            peers = full_node.getpeerinfo()
-            if len(peers) != 1:
-                return False
-            peer = peers[0]
-            return (
-                full_node.getblockcount() == 0
-                and peer["inflight"] == []
-                and peer["bytessent_per_msg"].get("getdata", 0) == 0
-            )
-
-        ensure_for(
-            duration=max(1.0, min(5.0, self.options.timeout_factor)),
-            f=no_block_request_from_limited_peer,
-        )
+        self.log.info("Check the full node is still connected but did not request any blocks.")
+        peers = full_node.getpeerinfo()
+        assert_equal(len(peers), 1)
+        assert_equal(full_node.getblockcount(), 0)
+        assert_equal(peers[0]["inflight"], [])
+        assert_equal(peers[0]["bytessent_per_msg"].get("getdata", 0), 0)
 
         # now connect also to node 1 (non pruned)
         self.connect_nodes(1, 2)
